description: Send a reminder email to signers who have not signed yet (all of them, or one by email). Server-side throttling applies: a signer reminded in the last 4 hours is skipped, not re-emailed — the response lists who was reminded and who was skipped.

signer_email.description: Remind only this signer; omit to remind all pending signers
